assessment: This is an important contribution where the authors describe the development of a new Early Warning System for patients with COVID-19, namely COEWS. In their convincing approach, they integrate sex, SpO2, complete blood count and blood glucose. A score equal to or higher than 6 represents a high risk for the admitted COVID-19 patient in need of oxygen to be intubated or die within 48 hours. The score is tested in a Spanish cohort and validated through a smaller Spanish cohort and a larger Argentinian one. It shows good performance, better than that of NEWS2. Hence the paper is relevant for clinicians.
